title: Reserve standalone dispatcher claims atomically
summary: Remediate AUDIT-FIND-W01-013 by giving the exported standalone QueueDispatcher a lock-backed claim, release, and terminal completion lifecycle.
reason: The documented claim surface currently peeks at queue_records[0] without reserving it, so repeated or concurrent callers can receive the same source under distinct job IDs.
affected_areas: generated source summaries and change-control evidence
behavior_before: Standalone claims leave the queue head visible, mark_done is a no-op, and concurrent calls can claim one record repeatedly.
behavior_after: A successful claim removes exactly one record under a lock, tracks it by job ID, release restores it at most once, and mark_done terminalizes ownership without restoring the record.
tests_added: claim removes and reserves exactly one synthetic record
public get_dispatcher factory reachability and standalone lifecycle smoke
release restores once and mark_done terminalizes once
